name: mFourier_single
statement: d → AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) (i : d) : mFourier (Pi.single i 1) z = fourier 1 (z i)

have_tree.body: Finset.prod_mul_prod_compl {i} (fun j ↦ fourier ((Pi.single i (1 : ℤ) : d → ℤ) j) (z j))

name: coe_measurableEquivPiIoc
statement: ⇑(measurableEquivPiIoc b) = fun x => ⟨fun i => (AddCircle.equivIoc 1 (b i) (x i)).1, fun i => (AddCircle.equivIoc 1 (b i) (x i)).2⟩

name: hasSum_mFourier_series_of_summable
statement: Summable (mFourierCoeff f)) : HasSum (fun i ↦ mFourierCoeff f i • mFourier i) f
